title: SLOW English Podcast --- Chat with me about foods!🌮

header.titleZh: 慢英文播客 --- 跟我聊聊美食！ 🌮
header.titleEn: SLOW English Podcast --- Chat with me about foods!🌮

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk to you about food.
sentences.tc: 今天我想和大家聊聊美食。

sentences.en: First of all I always enjoy sweets anything from cheesecake to candies to sweet bread.
sentences.tc: 首先，我總是喜歡甜食，從起司蛋糕到糖果到甜麵包。

sentences.en: I love it all but sweets are not very healthy for you.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡這一切，但甜食對你來說不太健康。

sentences.en: They have a lot of sugar.
Sugar can make you gain weight, but it is also very delicious.
sentences.tc: 糖會讓人發胖，但它也非常美味。

sentences.en: I think it's worth it some people like salty food more than sweets.
sentences.tc: 我認為有些人比甜食更喜歡鹹食，這是值得的。

sentences.en: What do you like more salty Foods or sweet Foods?
sentences.tc: 你喜歡鹹的食物還是甜的食物？

sentences.en: I think people who like sweet foods are often very sweet.
sentences.tc: 我覺得喜歡吃甜食的人往往都是很甜的。

sentences.en: People who like salty foods are often direct and straightforward. That's just my opinion.
sentences.tc: 喜歡鹹食的人往往是直接、直接的。這只是我的意見。

sentences.en: We have lots of yummy foods foods that are spicy sweet salty sour bitter.
sentences.tc: 我們有很多美味的食物，有辣的、甜的、鹹的、酸的、苦的。
